annotation.title_clean: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI
annotation.title_en: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA business-oriented paper arguing that responsible AI should be measured by human well-being and planetary metrics (UN SDGs, ESG, IEEE 7010) rather than financial KPIs alone. It offers Assess/Apply/Amplify recommendations and a readiness framework. It contains no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Define responsible AI through expanded KPIs including well-being, UN SDGs and ESG metrics across the AIS life cycle.
Use IEEE Std 7010 well-being impact assessment and IEEE 7000 for value-based design.
Adopt Well-being by Design and a Well-being Metrics Readiness Framework.
Appoint Responsible AI champions and leverage DPO-like roles and ESG reporting.
Use ethical conformity assessment such as IEEE CertifAIEd.
